actions.title: Field-test D097 quota-safe HA and network transition
actions.provider: Physical Beta PDA + Windows PRIMARY/STANDBY Agents on normal and Office networks
actions.reason_owner_only: Connected CI can verify source/build/Rules/indexes and synthetic guards but cannot physically switch the company laptop network or prove real multi-machine failover behavior.
shortest_test_path: Update PRIMARY/STANDBY Windows Agents to relay-agent-v22 and the Picker PDA to the signed Beta APK released from the same D097 main.
Normal network: send one controlled confirmation request. Expect a normal successful round trip within the 10-second target when WMS data is valid.

Keep Agent running and switch the PRIMARY laptop between normal Internet and Office. Do not restart Agent. Verify temporary DNS/proxy transition is shown as reconnecting and the role is not falsely lost merely because the Windows route is changing.
With two WMS-ready Agents, make PRIMARY unable to reach/process Firestore and send a new request. At request age >=10 seconds STANDBY must take over; only one WMS mutation may occur.
Restore the old PRIMARY. It must not steal the already-processed request. The new PRIMARY may later select another WMS-ready Agent as STANDBY.
Make both usable Agents unavailable for one request. At 30 seconds the PDA must stop automatic handling and direct the Picker to the specialist desk.
Provide only sanitized Agent/PDA logs if any step fails; never share passwords, tokens, cookies, WMS headers/signatures or encrypted session files.
pass_criteria: Normal Internet and Office use the same Firestore carrier; no RTDB/Cloudflare/Apps Script fallback produces PASS.
PRIMARY polls at the D097 bounded cadence, STANDBY takes over only after the 10-second request-age gate, and FROZEN Agents do not poll business work.
Network transition does not falsely declare the PRIMARY dead solely because Windows temporarily exposes DIRECT/DNS/proxy transition state.
A request that reaches the 30-second terminal boundary is not started as new automatic WMS work and the PDA shows specialist-desk guidance.
Conditional ACK plus full-PickListCode guard prevent duplicate WMS mutation during PRIMARY/STANDBY races and old-PRIMARY recovery.
D096 exact resolver, confirmSkipItem payload/endpoint and Status=true success semantics remain unchanged.
Báo hàng remains independent on Worker/InventoryCore.
Stable remains untouched.
actions.safety: Beta only. Use controlled eligible Picklists for any real WMS confirmation. Do not run a 30-real-mutation burst against company WMS merely to load-test transport; concurrency/quota stress must use bounded synthetic/non-WMS evidence unless Owner explicitly authorizes otherwise.
actions.superseded_reason: D098 released newer Agent v23 + beta-vc61 while preserving D097 HA semantics. OA019 consolidates D098 identity/realtime/specialist acceptance with the retained D097 normal→Office, STANDBY takeover and 30-second fallback scenarios.

actions.title: Field-accept D098 unified Firebase identity, realtime and specialist Agent flow
actions.provider: Beta Web + signed Android PDA + company Windows Agent + authorized Supra WMS session
actions.reason_owner_only: Connected CI can verify source/build/deploy/Rules and synthetic session guards but cannot operate the Owner's physical Web/PDA/Office laptop combination or execute the controlled company-WMS specialist confirmation.
shortest_test_path: Use released relay-agent-v25 and signed beta-vc62 with Beta Web. Do not use older Agent v23/v24 for final acceptance.
With one ADMIN username/MNV, keep Web + App + Agent logged in simultaneously. Then force a second Web, second App and second Agent one at a time; each replacement must affect only its own channel.
Verify PICKER is App-only, REPORTER/ROOT work on App+Web, and only real ADMIN can log in to Agent using username/MNV + password.

On the Office network start/restart Agent without Cloudflare access. Verify direct/saved Firebase ADMIN authentication and Firestore relay become usable; no prior Web login should be required after D098 deployment migration.
Verify Beta Web realtime is connected and a controlled Báo hàng change appears on another authorized client without F5; reconnect once and verify bounded recovery.

D097 retained network scenario: keep PRIMARY running and switch normal Internet → Office without restarting Agent. A temporary route transition must not falsely erase PRIMARY solely because DNS/proxy is changing.

D097 retained failover scenario: with two WMS-ready Agents, make PRIMARY unable to process a new request. At request age >=10 seconds STANDBY takes over; only one WMS mutation may occur. Old PRIMARY recovery must not replay it.
D097 retained terminal scenario: make usable Agents unavailable for one request. At 30 seconds PDA must stop new automatic handling and direct the Picker to the specialist desk.

Agent specialist scenario: enter 3–5 digits, select the intended full PickListCode from the matches, confirm exactly once, and verify the result in SFT/SFT3. If the result is uncertain, do not press again.
pass_criteria: Firebase is credential authority; InventoryCore remains role/status/business authority; active ADMIN migration completed at deployment.
One WEB + one ANDROID + one AGENT slot per eligible user works concurrently and same-channel replacement never revokes the other two.
Role/client matrix is enforced server-side: PICKER App-only, REPORTER/ROOT App+Web, ADMIN App+Web+Agent.
ROOT/ADMIN registered recovery email + Firebase reset-link flow works without exposing account existence.
Web realtime uses the repaired shared V2 session, updates without F5 and reconnects with bounded backoff/delta recovery.
Agent ADMIN login/refresh works through Firebase/Google without Inventory Worker dependency on Office.
D097 PRIMARY/STANDBY/FROZEN semantics, 10-second takeover, 30-second specialist fallback and no duplicate WMS mutation remain intact.
Specialist search accepts only 3–5 digits, searches anywhere in cached full PickListCode, requires explicit full-code selection and never ACKs an APK job.
Specialist confirmation uses the one-write cross-Agent guard and only reports confirmed when WMS returns HTTP 2xx + Status=true; uncertain results fail closed.
Normal Báo hàng remains Worker/InventoryCore and Agent-independent; Stable remains untouched.
actions.safety: Beta only. Use an eligible controlled PickList for the specialist confirm. Do not share passwords, Firebase tokens, cookies, WMS headers/signatures, encrypted session files or sensitive payloads.
actions.remaining_owner_action: Use relay-agent-v25 + beta-vc62 for the consolidated physical acceptance matrix.

actions.title: Field-accept D100 ROOT System Reset and recovery mail
actions.provider: Beta Web + InventoryCore + Firebase Auth + Gmail send OAuth
actions.reason_owner_only: Connected CI can verify source/build/runtime guards but cannot use the Owner's ROOT password, receive the six-digit email OTP, or authorize/execute destructive reset scopes on production-like Beta data.
shortest_test_path: Log in as the real ROOT identity on Beta Web and confirm HỆ THỐNG → Đặt lại hệ thống is visible only while base/effective role is ROOT.

First perform the safe mail-only part: select any reset scope, enter the current ROOT password and request the six-digit OTP. Stop before executing the reset. Confirm the OTP arrives at the configured ROOT recovery email.

If the UI returns RESET_EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE / Gmail send permission missing, perform one bounded Google OAuth re-consent granting gmail.send in addition to the existing Drive scope, then retry the mail-only challenge.

When ready to validate deletion, choose only an explicitly approved non-critical/test scope. Review the preview/counts, enter ROOT password + emailed OTP, execute once, then verify only that selected runtime scope returns to zero.
Verify ROOT identity, ROOT password, ROOT recovery email, source/schema/UI/logic, external Google Sheet rows and Drive files remain unchanged.
For CONFIRMATION_RELAY scope, do not execute while any relay job is PENDING; the service must refuse it.
Optionally request a ROOT/ADMIN recovery email and confirm the project-issued link is single-use and expires after 15 minutes; only change a password when intentionally testing recovery.
pass_criteria: System Reset navigation and APIs are accessible only to base ROOT with current effective ROOT role.
Reset challenge requires the current ROOT password and a six-digit email OTP; no reset occurs merely by requesting the code.
Only approved selected runtime data is zeroed. Reset never changes source, schema/table definitions, business logic, workflows or UI.
ROOT identity, password, recovery email and Firebase UID are preserved.
External Google Sheet and Google Drive contents are never deleted by System Reset.
Picker/Reporter/Admin account reset removes only the corresponding InventoryCore/Firebase identities; ROOT is excluded.
Confirmation-relay reset refuses to run while a PENDING relay job exists.
Gmail is used only for send; no Gmail read scope is introduced.
Recovery link is enumeration-safe, hashed server-side, single-use and expires after 15 minutes.
Stable remains untouched.
actions.safety: Beta only. Review selected scopes before execute. Do not share ROOT password, OTP, OAuth refresh token, Firebase tokens, cookies or any secret values. Requesting the OTP alone is non-destructive; final reset execution is destructive for the selected runtime data.
actions.field_result_note: Owner confirmed post-reset re-test PASS after PR #133: normal operational surfaces/realtime recovered, managed account creation works, and SKU import completes. Reset deletion behavior had already been confirmed correct. OA020 is closed PASS on Beta.

actions.title: Field-accept D101 Agent v26 operational rework
actions.provider: Beta Windows Agent + Firestore relay + authorized Supra WMS + Beta Drive logs + Beta Web
actions.reason_owner_only: CI can verify source/build/rules/deploy guards but cannot prove the Owner's physical Windows Wi-Fi name, multi-Agent role display, real running auto-update, real WMS refresh after a stale cache miss, or scheduled/crash Drive delivery from the company laptop.
shortest_test_path: Install/update to relay-agent-v26 after release and keep Agent running.
Verify Hệ thống Agent shows actual Wi-Fi SSID, this machine role, and online/PRIMARY/STANDBY/FROZEN counts; Web Người đang online must still count only Web + PDA.
Search a PickList that was absent from the previous cache but exists on WMS. Cache miss must refresh and then find it without restarting Agent. Repeat from PDA five-digit path where practical.
Verify each manual PickList result row has its own Xác nhận button and one controlled confirmation still obeys D096/D097 idempotency/fail-closed rules.
Verify no Cài đặt top-level tab remains and the promoted direct tabs are usable.
Leave Agent running through a newer GitHub prerelease or controlled version test; it must discover the update in the background without a manual restart.

Verify local logs rotate by size without creating a new pair each process start. Confirm scheduled Agent bundle reaches Inventory/Beta/Logs at the next slot; for a controlled synthetic crash test only, verify a crash_ log is delivered/retried without exposing secrets.
pass_criteria: Final NOT_FOUND is possible only after the miss-triggered WMS refresh attempt.
Background Agent update works while process is already running and retains SHA-256/trusted-origin checks.
Agent/Supra information and Wi-Fi SSID are truthful and readable.
PRIMARY/STANDBY/FROZEN counts are visible without introducing fast Firestore presence polling.
Web online totals exclude Agent.
Rolling logs stay bounded and scheduled/crash Agent logs reach Beta Drive through the temporary Firestore spool.
Logout requires confirmation; flat tabs and row-level confirm match D101.
Stable remains untouched.
actions.safety: Beta only. Do not share Firebase tokens, WMS cookies/headers/signatures, passwords or local DPAPI files. Use only a controlled eligible PickList for any real WMS confirm. Crash test should be synthetic and bounded; do not intentionally corrupt company Windows.
actions.remaining_owner_action: Run the OA021 physical field matrix on released relay-agent-v26. No code/build/deploy blocker remains.
